title: Agent Reach: Which Sites Actually Work
description:
62,660 stars for the repo that gives Claude Code eyes on the internet. Six channels work the second it installs, the ones you actually wanted need your own login, and there is a burner-account warning sitting in their own readme.

#shorts #claudecode #agentreach
